issues.on_page: C-1 Capital Outlay: Improvements other than buildings 2,722,523
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: C-1 Buildings 0, Improvements other than buildings 2,722,523 and Machinery and equipment 99,566 set to category capital outlay, labelled 'Capital Outlay: Streets and Highways' (printed text in printed_label, function in computed)] This line is printed under the Streets schedule's Capital Outlay heading. The user's capital outlay rule (2026-10-26) puts every capital outlay line, including one inside a function, in category capital outlay, labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>'. The same applies to detail[149] Machinery and equipment 99,566 and detail[147] Buildings 0. As recorded, 2,822,089 of capital outlay is counted as streets spending.
